messages:
Maya: quick ping — PR #4823 adds sundial-7b model config + tokenizer tweaks + sparse-quant profile. Need merge by EOD tomorrow for staging smoke. Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4823 :eyes:
Sam: I can take a first pass in ~1h. Any failing tests locally?
Maya: ran unit tests + basic tokenization smoke. CI showed a helm lint flake. I fixed a small typo in tokenizer tests in the last commit.
Arjun: I can review the quant profile later today. @Liam can you sanity-check the runtime flags? we changed kv cache shard config.
Liam: Yep can do this afternoon. Quick q: why `kv_cache_shard=4`? can we keep it <4 to reduce memory pressure?
Maya: kv_cache_shard=4 came from the model card perf notes — helps throughput for long-context. I added a note in the PR under "runtime tradeoffs". We can back it off if we see mem spikes.
Jessica: left an inline comment about tokenizer regex — possible edge-case with leading emojis that breaks split. small test suggestion included.
Sam: pushed a tiny fix for the helm lint in a follow-up commit. CI re-run requested.
infra-bot: CI status for PR #4823 — unit-tests: ✅, tokenizer-smoke: ✅, helm-lint: ❌. Re-run queued by @Sam.
Liam: :eyes: will review KV sizing and runtime flags. ETA ~3pm PT.
Maya: smoke test command I used locally:
```bash
python -m tests.tokenizer_smoke --model sundial-7b --input 'hello'
```
Maya: if reviewers can give :shipit: or request changes, aiming to merge by 11am PT tomorrow. tagging @eng-oncall in case staging deploy needs attention.
eng-oncall: noted — if merged before 11am PT we'll run the staging smoke and watch logs. Ping me after merge.
Sam: :shipit: from my side once lint passes.
Arjun: looks good for quant profile, approving and left a note about log level.
Maya: thanks all — merging once CI clears and I see the green. I'll monitor the staging job and report back here.
